scope: Independent read-only review of final frozen requirements, architecture, part repetition, sourcing and physical-envelope complexity. The manifest, source hashes and check-artifact hashes were independently verified. Final native-check summaries and illustrative top3D were inspected; native electrical/CAD checks were not rerun in this role. No fabrication approval, purchase, supplier contact or powered test.

actual_final_design.C1_C4: Both KEMET R71PF315050H6K,150nF630V. Interim R66 47nF400V is excluded.
actual_final_design.assembly_process: Manual laboratory assembly; all tall THT bodies on front, SMD components on rear. Illustrative engineering envelope models, not supplierSTEP certification.

preliminary_finding_closure.evidence: Final C1 is150nF630V, replacing interim47nF400V; C4 note that C1 changed from47nF now correctly describes the final variant. BOM, README, engineering status and input-filter source agree on two150nF630V parts.

findings.evidence: Every selected MPN has a TME offer, but all_parts_current_stock_confirmed remains false. Several offers have cached stock or failed fresh checks. R6 and the four-part OVP resistor have MOQ100 records. LYT1603D is NRND.
findings.consequence: One supplier and16MPNs simplify procurement, but they do not establish a currently purchasable complete prototype set or a stable production supply chain.
findings.closure: Retain truthful per-MPN freshness and resolve exact stock/MOQ before calling this an available complete order. Track under existing TME-STOCK; no redundant alternate-controller redesign requested.
findings.blocked_claim: Complete currently available TME order; not saving an explicit engineering candidate

findings.evidence: Final board51.2x37mm is12.1% wider than33mm preference. MountedT1~22.5mm plus1.6mmPCB and2.9mm rearBR1 yields~27mm total,35% above20mm target. T1 alone exceeds the old total-height target.
findings.consequence: The TME sourcing choice is a real dimensional tradeoff. Routing cleanup alone cannot restore the20mm envelope with this magnetic component.
findings.closure: Continue to show exact dimensions and target miss. Prove actual mechanical fit or accept a concrete revised envelope before a normal-bulb fit claim. No invented fit from a 3D render.
findings.blocked_claim: Fits prior envelope or ordinary bulb; not saving an explicit separate candidate

findings.evidence: Frozen assessment includes401object-pair hits across231 enumerated net pairs, no exceptions; full Toolkit release FAIL. T1 fault-current, input-transient, fuse/resistor/MOV coordination and physical thermal/ripple gates remain open.
findings.consequence: Reducing component count, retaining an existing controller or passing native manufacturing DRC cannot close these electrical/clearance issues. The frozen packet correctly stays NOTFORORDERORPOWEREDTEST.
findings.closure: Use existing electrical/spacing blockers and independent closure checks; do not remove required protection or weaken criteria merely to simplify the board.
findings.blocked_claim: Manufacturing/energization acceptance or qualified functional-insulation pass

simplicity_assessment: Two-layer single-controller architecture with no dimming or firmware is suitably modest for this sourcing variant. A full alternative external-MOSFET/controller topology is not a necessary simplification of this task.
Using the same630V150nF part forC1/C4 reduces uniqueMPNs from17to16 and removes the interim400VC1. This is coherent part consolidation; it does not itself prove nonlinear surge/filter behavior.

Three47uF output capacitors have a documented sourcing/ripple rationale. OneUCD150uF would remove2positions and4 solder joints, but lower120Hz ripple rating and unverified hot performance prevent calling that a qualified replacement.

Four97.6k resistors distribute voltage among sourced200V1206 parts; no verified in-stock singleHV390k substitution was established. Parallel sense resistors achieve the desired value. Dual bleeders preserve one-open discharge coverage. None is demonstrated redundant.

SeparateF1 is needed because a replacement resistor's mains interruption was not demonstrated. Do not remove fuse, MOV, bypass capacitor or input filter solely to save area; their actual coordination still requires proof.
recommendation: blocked_for_release; appropriately simple explicit engineering candidate may be saved and reviewed with all open findings. No human approval or completed all-stock claim.
